text: tools/formula-bump <tag> refuses a missing tag, a lightweight tag, a wrong argument count, and a formula without exactly one tag: and one revision: line, changing nothing in each case. For an annotated tag it rewrites exactly those two lines, to the tag and git rev-parse <tag>^{commit}, and prints the diff.
